eps.t: The End of Flutter Valley: Part 1
eps.d: The Ponies are on their way to Flutter Valley for the "Sun Tuesday" celebration with the Flutter Ponies. Meanwhile, the Witches from the Volcano of Gloom are busy hatching a plan to destroy Flutter Valley and the Ponies.

eps.t: The End of Flutter Valley: Part 2
eps.d: The witches from the Volcano of Gloom have devised a way to steal the Flutter Ponies' Sunstone. Without the Sunstone, Flutter Valley will wither and die! The witches have enlisted the help of Queen Bumble and the bees from Bumleland, who also hate the Flutter Ponies, to steal the Sunstone and take it to Bumbleland where it will help flowers grow so they have all the nectar they need.

eps.t: The End of Flutter Valley: Part 3
eps.d: The Bumbles steal the Sunstone and take it back to Bumbleland, where it promptly melts the snow and grows hundreds of flowers. The Flutter Ponies are captured and put in a honeycomb prison. After trying to use their wings to blow the prison apart, Queen Bumble orders honey to be thrown into the prison to immobolize their wings.

eps.t: The End of Flutter Valley: Part 4
eps.d: Morning Glory manages to escape the Honeycomb Prison, but her wings still have honey on them, and she can't fly fast enough to escape Queen Bumbles' swarm. She is recaptured and guarded by Sting in her own cage on the other side of Bumbleland. Meanwhile, the Ponies finally make it to Furbobia and the Furbobs fix Baby Cuddles' leg.

eps.t: The End of Flutter Valley: Part 5
eps.d: Bumbleland continues to get hotter and hotter as the Sunstone overheats. By now the flowers and trees are catching fire. Sting and Morning Glory start to bond while he is guarding her, and he lets it slip that he can't fly. Morning Glory offers to teach him, but Sting won't let her out of the cage. The Ponies make it to Flutter Valley, but are ambushed by the witches and their giant pet spider.

eps.t: The End of Flutter Valley: Part 6
eps.d: Morning Glory and Sting escape Bumbleland to find help.

eps.t: The End of Flutter Valley: Part 7
eps.d: Morning Glory and Sting convince Megan to come back with them to Ponyland to help save Flutter Valley.

eps.t: The End of Flutter Valley: Part 8
eps.d: Megan and the others come to free the Flutter Ponies, but end up captured themselves!

eps.t: The End of Flutter Valley: Part 9
eps.d: Furbob is afraid of the Stonebacks, but Megan convinces him that they are friends, not enemies.

eps.t: The End of Flutter Valley: Part 10
eps.d: Will the ponies be able to get the Sunstone back in place to save Flutter Valley before the sun sets?

eps.t: The Ghost of Paradise Estate: Part 1
eps.d: There's a menacing ghost inside Paradise Estate! The ghost turns out to be a shape-shifter named Pluma, who has come to reclaim half of an amulet that is buried underneath Paradise Estate. She's been forced to find the amulet by Squirk, who has kidnapped her grandfather until she can bring the amulet to him.

eps.t: The Ghost of Paradise Estate: Part 2
eps.d: Megan and Molly defend the little ponies against the ghost but its no use. Nobody can catch the ghost. The little ponies, Megan and her siblings must catch the ghost of Paradise Estate.

eps.t: The Ghost of Paradise Estate: Part 3
eps.d: Paradise Estate is partially restored, and the Ponies help the mysterious creature battle Squirk the Evil Octopus.

eps.t: The Ghost of Paradise Estate: Part 4

eps.d: A pair of monkeys called Gizmonks take Danny and Surprise prisoner until Megan turns over the Rainbow of Light to them.

Dream Valley is full of activity as the Little Ponies train for the Pony Olympics. What the ponies don't know is that three Raptorians are flying overhead in search of magical material to repair Princess Porcina's cloak. The Raptorians think their search is over when they discover that the ponies are magical creatures.

The Bushwoolies spy the Raptorians taking Lickety-Split, Gusty, and Heart Throb to the Black Mountains and rush to Paradise Estate to tell the others. Megan takes Magic Star, Paradise, and North Star to rescue them, letting the Bushwoolies lead the way. None of them notices Shady and Molly secretly following as backup rescuers.

The Raptorians discover that the captured ponies' hair grows back instantly once cut off. Not only are Lickety-Split, Gusty, and Heart Throb then forced to stay, but they are also ordered to weave Porcina's new cloak themselves. The search party is reunited with the catpured ponies only after the magic cloak has been finished and delivered to Porcina.

Shady and Molly reveal themselves to their friends; Shady then devises a plan to make a fake cloak out of shed Bushwoolie hair so that they can exchange it for Porcina's cloak and reverse the spell. Everything goes fine until the switch has to be made: the lights go out, the cloaks get mixed up, and Megan is forced to guess which one is real when the Raptorians arrive.

The Ponies find a puppy and decide to keep her and build her a doghouse and name her Dinah. When the new puppy is reunited with her family the following Spring, the Ponies are sad to see her go, but they realize that even though friends come and go they will never leave their hearts.

Baby Heart Throb, Baby Lofty and Baby Half Note want to sing backup for Knight Shade. But to their dismay, he has stolen their shadows, which contain all of their energy and substance. The Ponies soon discover that the evil wizard Arabus is behind Knight Shade's behavior, and now it's up to the Flutter Ponies to save the day.

Baby Heart Throb, Baby Lofty and Baby Half Note want to sing backup for Knight Shade. But to their dismay, he has stolen their shadows, which contain all of their energy and substance. The Ponies soon discover that the evil wizard Arabus is behind Knight Shade's behavior, and now it's up to the Flutter Ponies to save the day.

Megan and Molly take Baby Heart Throb, Baby Lofty and Baby Half Note to a concert featuring their favorite singer, Night Shade and his back up singers, the Shadowets. After the concert is over, Baby Heart Throb and the other baby ponies meet Night Shade and get their shadows stolen, which leaves them feeling sick and very dizzy.
Zeb and Erebus nearly steal everyone's shadow before Molly's ride for help is a success.

eps.t: Sweet Stuff and the Treasure Hunt
eps.d: Sweet Stuff wants to play games with everyone else, but feels left out because she is an Earth Pony and doesn't seem to be good at anything. She ends up surprising everyone (even herself!) when she joins a treasure hunt with the pegasi and is the only one able to answer the last riddle and win the game!
The other unicorns winking has been intercepted. Buttons, Baby Ribbons, Ribbon and Galaxy all get taken away to the lost city. Ribbon telepathically tells Megan they are in Tambelons Lost City.

Megan, her siblings and the little ponies have arrived at Tambelon's kingdom in hope of saving the unicorns. Tambelon catches all creatures except for two flutter ponies and some grundles Megan and her friends must come up with a plan.

The little ponies are unsure on how to defeat Grogar. Wind Whistler notices about his bell around his neck and thinks it may be the key to defeat him and get the unicorns back. Surprise comes up with a plan to take back Paradise Estate.

The baby Ponies are bored and want Ribbon and Buttons to play a game with them. Ribbon suggests that they play a game of Make Believe and runs out to go get them a red ball to use in their game. She explains that the red ball is magic and can be anything they want it to be. While she's gone the baby Ponies take turns imagining what the red ball will be...

A drought has come upon Pony Land causing the sea ponies to not feel well. Ribbon, Whizzer, Lofty, Lickety-Split, Danny and Molly take the sea ponies to find some water. The others go to find the Moochick in search of help about the coins.
Niblick the Troll agrees to end the drought in Ponyland, if Megan and the Ponies will bring him something equal in value to the used Magic Coins.
After a magical mishap, Fizzy, Shady, Wind Whistler and Gusty must live each other's lives until they can restore the balance of nature.
Four Ponies go underground and turn everything upside down.
A jinxed little man turns up at Paradise Estate, and the Ponies won't let him go
Posey finds some sentient flowers wandering around her garden and offers them shelter and water, but she has no idea what they have in store for her to repay her kindness!
The Flouries have taken Masquerade hostage and are on their way to sucking the life out of Dream Valley unless the ponies can stop them!
Spike is harassed by a young boy trying to become a knight. The Ponies help him to find a good deed that doesn't involve slaying their friend.

eps.t: The Revolt of Paradise Estate: Part 1
The Revolt of Paradise Estate: Part 2
eps.d: After being kicked out of their home by their furniture the Ponies seek out the help of the Moochick. The Moochick tells the Ponies that Beason is really a powerful sorcerer that gave them the paint so he could steal Paradise Estate. The Ponies decide they won't give up without a fight and rush home to fight Beason.

eps.d: When Spike discovers that he can now breathe fire, he searches for other dragons who can teach him to control it. When he finds some, he learns more than he bargained for.

The First Tooth Baby Ponies are put in charge of the Newborn Twines: Sniffles & Snookums and Milkweed & Tumbleweed. The unruly twins are temporarily subdued with the promise of ice cream, but the First Tooth Baby Ponies must first reunite feuding ice cream makers Rocky Ripple and Fudgy McSwain, who have cut off Ponyland's ice cream supply.
The Ponies come to the aid of two wronged royals when the attend an exclusive party at the Palace de Branforr. Meanwhile, the First Tooth Baby Ponies learn to be careful what they wish for.
